text:
Marta: Heads-up 6:40 UTC 6 - noticed a bunch of accounts marked 'onboarding_complete' yesterday even though their activity logs show no step completions. ~350 accounts in the digest.
Liam: saw that too. playbook shows 'complete' events coming from partner-webhook ingestion. suspect mapping change.
Anya: partner sent a new aggregate payload variant last week that has `completed_steps_count` instead of explicit `steps` array. our mapper treats any numeric >0 as completed, but partner uses it as a summary including cancelled steps.
partner-webhook-bot: :information_source: webhook-recv: 2026-08-11T06:35:12Z batch_id 554321 (source: partner-y)
Marta: example from the audit log (redacted):
```
{"account_id": 700912, "completed_steps_count": 1, "steps_status": null, "source": "partner-y"}
```
Liam: our old events had `steps_status: [{"step":"email_verified","status":"done"}]` and we required any status=='done' to mark completion. new mapping allowed summary to short-circuit.
Anya: quick query to find affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, completed_steps_count, steps_status, onboarding_state
FROM cs_ingest.partner_events
WHERE source = 'partner-y' AND change_ts BETWEEN '2026-08-10 00:00' AND '2026-08-11 12:00'
AND onboarding_state = 'onboarding_complete';
```
Liam: ran it - ~358 rows. ~84% have null `steps_status`. many are low-touch trials.
Marta: consequence: playbooks fired renewal-ready and NPS flows prematurely. CS ops reported a few confused customers.
Anya: mitigation: 1) revert mapping that interprets `completed_steps_count` as canonical completion; 2) add validation to require either non-empty `steps_status` or an explicit `complete=true` flag; 3) run a targeted reversion for accounts marked complete in the window and recompute `onboarding_state`.
ops-bot: :information_source: Ingest-service: rolling tag ingest/fix/20260811 created by Anya at 06:52 UTC
Liam: we should also backfill `steps_status` where partner still has details via the partner API before recompute. I'll open a partner-data-request ticket and attach sample account ids.
Marta: SQL to list sample IDs for partner ticket:
```
SELECT distinct account_id
FROM cs_ingest.partner_events
WHERE source = 'partner-y' AND change_ts BETWEEN '2026-08-10 00:00' AND '2026-08-11 12:00'
LIMIT 200;
```
Anya: short-term hotfix: deploy a mapper patch that treats `completed_steps_count` as advisory only; if `steps_status` is null, set `onboarding_state` = 'in_progress' and emit `ingest_warning` tag. will push in the next 10m.
Marta: agree. also add an ops queue item for accounts that were auto-moved to 'complete' so CS can follow up where needed before we rollback.
Liam: I'll schedule the recompute: run recompute_onboarding_state(account_ids) on the sampled list and then a larger backfill using snapshot_20260811_0600 after partner provides details. ETA for sample recompute ~45m.
cs-bot: :information_source: Playbook-runner: pausing outbound "welcome-survey" for cohort=trial-partner-y (requested by Marta)
Marta: good call on pausing outbound. let's also add an alert: any ingest mapping that flips >1% of onboarding_state to 'onboarding_complete' in 30m should trigger an ops review.
Anya: will add the alert and a unit test for the mapper to reject summary-only completions without explicit flag.
Liam: follow-ups: 1) partner ticket with sample accounts (I'll attach CSV), 2) hotfix mapper patch (Anya), 3) recompute and backfill plan (Liam), 4) runbook update to include partner schema-change checklist.
Marta: thanks team. once recompute finishes let's reconvene and confirm outbound resume. :thumbsup:
